response.text: {"name":"Počasi, hitro, hitro","idea":"The page is built like a bar of music, the takt the school is named for: vertical rules divide every section into measures, and the rhythm words a dance teacher calls out in the hall run across the screen as the one line of ornament.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#15121a"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#221d2a"},{"role":"text","hex":"#f1ecf2"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#b8adbd"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#e8473f"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#1a0d0c"},{"role":"band","hex":"#e8473f"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#1a0d0c"},{"role":"border","hex":"#3b3444"}],"pairing":"bricolage-figtree","typeCharacter":"Bricolage Grotesque is loud, slightly wonky and physical, like a body on a floor; it is used only for the h1 at about 10vw and section headings at 4 to 5vw, sentence case, weight 800, tight leading, always left-aligned; Figtree carries all running text at 18 to 20px, weight 400, with the muted tint for secondary lines and no uppercase anywhere.","composition":"Section 1 (hero, deep ground #15121a, 4 rows): thin vertical rules in #3b3444 at column lines 4, 7 and 10 run the full section height like bar lines; the h1 sits in columns 1 to 8, rows 1 to 2, at about 10vw; the lead in Figtree spans columns 1 to 5 in row 3; the one button (square corners, red #e8473f fill, dark text) sits under the lead in row 4 with the phone as a plain line beside it; columns 9 to 12, rows 1 to 4 hold a simple line drawing in #e8473f of a waltz box step: two pairs of shoe outlines with three arrows, drawn on the dark ground. Section 2 (band, full-width red #e8473f, 1 row): a ribbon of short words in dark text, Bricolage at about 3vw, repeating 'počasi · hitro · hitro · počasi' across the width, slowly scrolling. Section 3 (offerings, ground #15121a, 2 rows): heading 'Naši tečaji in cene' in columns 1 to 6; the four offerings as a list with a rule between each row, name in Bricolage on the left spanning columns 1 to 5, duration or rhythm (10 srečanj, 3 ure, mesečno) on the right in columns 7 to 12, line 'Cene veljajo za posamezen tečaj' in muted under the list. Section 4 (story, surface #221d2a across columns 1 to 7 only, 2 rows): heading 'Prvo srečanje je brezplačno' at 5vw, text in columns 1 to 6; columns 8 to 12 stay on the dark ground with a compact week strip showing ponedeljek to četrtek marked and petek to nedelja unmarked, labelled 'zvečer, urnik po skupini'. Section 5 (highlights, dark ground, 2 rows): heading 'Kdo vas uči' in columns 1 to 4; in columns 5 to 12 the two names Eva Pečovnik and Rok Pečovnik set as two large Bricolage lines at about 6vw stacked, with the line about the former competitive couple and the Plesna zveza Slovenije licence under them in Figtree; no portraits. Section 6 (call, band red #e8473f, 3 rows): heading 'Prijavite se na tečaj' in columns 1 to 7; the phone number as a large numeral at about 7vw in columns 1 to 8, row 2; email, address Francetova cesta 7, Slovenj Gradec and a simple schematic map in columns 9 to 12; the single action button in dark fill with light text in row 3.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere. The only picture is one line drawing in the hero: a box-step diagram made of four shoe outlines and three arrows in red on the dark ground, sized to fill columns 9 to 12. Rules in #3b3444 act as bar lines in the hero and as list dividers elsewhere; the red band carries the rhythm ribbon.
